entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. Order number is VF-66291B. Just tell me how to do it.

Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. I can definitely help with that. Let me just pull up that order... VF-66291B. Okay, I see it here. The VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered 19 days ago. To get started, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the band?

It's not a fault. I don't want it. Listen, I had a family emergency right after it arrived. My husband's deployment date got moved up unexpectedly and I had to fly out. Then I ended up in the hospital for an unexpected surgery. I just got back. So, can I return it or not?
Oh, wow. That sounds like a lot to deal with. I'm sorry to hear that and I hope everything is okay now. Let me just check the return eligibility for you, one moment.
Just a yes or no is fine.
Okay, I've checked the policy. Yes, absolutely. You're unfortunately outside the 10-day window, so we can definitely process that return for you. No problem at all.
Great. So you're sending a label?

I am. I've just initiated the return in our system. A prepaid shipping label has been sent to the email address we have on file. Simply print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off. You'll receive a full refund to your original payment method once we receive the item back at our warehouse.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
